rubric.description: Uses the parameter celsius in the calculation
Applies the conversion formula correctly, using floating-point division (9.0/5.0, not integer division 9/5)
Returns the computed Fahrenheit value with a return statement
Divides the sum using floating-point division (e.g. by 3.0), not integer division by 3
Uses both parameters in the calculation
Multiplies quantity by unitPrice (int * double widens automatically to double)
